messages.author: 08d7d872077e52b9
messages.subject: Issue installing Nimble with Rtools 40
parts:
Hello,

I've been having some trouble installing Nimble. I recently updated R to version 4.0.0, and reinstalled Rtools 40. However, when I try to run the pump example (https://r-nimble.org/nimbleExamples/nimble_basic_mcmc.html), I get the following error:

compiling... this may take a minute. On some systems there may be some compiler warnings that can be safely ignored.
Error: Failed to create the shared library.
"C:/rtools40/mingw64/bin/"g++ -std=gnu++11  -I"//isad.isadroot.ex.ac.uk/UOE/User/R/R-4.0.0/include" -DNDEBUG -DR_NO_REMAP -I"\\isad.isadroot.ex.ac.uk\UOE\User\R\R-4.0.0\library\nimble\include" -I"" -I"" -DEIGEN_MPL2_ONLY=1 -Wno-misleading-indentation -Wno-ignored-attributes -Wno-deprecated-declarations         -O2 -Wall  -mfpmath=sse -msse2 -mstackrealign -c dynamicRegistrations_06_08_08_54_27.cpp -o dynamicRegistrations_06_08_08_54_27.o
dynamicRegistrations_06_08_08_54_27.cpp:1:10: fatal error: nimble/dynamicRegistrations.h: No such file or directory
 #include <nimble/dynamicRegistrations.h>
          ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
compilation terminated.
make: *** [//isad.isadroot.ex.ac.uk/UOE/User/R/R-4.0.0/etc/x64/Makeconf:229: dynamicRegistrations_06_08_08_54_27.o] Error 1

Has anyone else experienced this, or know what the problem might be?

Thanks,
Debbie

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Issue installing Nimble with Rtools 40
parts:
Hi Debbie,

I want to point you to the information here: https://r-nimble.org/download.  It includes a  note about R 4.0.0 and Rtools.  We made a fix in nimble 0.9.1 for  R 4.0.0, but still there is a step described on the Rtools page (linked from our page) for setting the PATH variable that is important.  Do these help?

-Perry

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Issue installing Nimble with Rtools 40
parts:
Debbie and I had some previous discussion off-list, and I don't think
this is a PATH issue.

Debbie, it looks like something is weird with one of the flags used
when the compilation is done -- namely the
'-I"\\isad.isadroot.ex.ac.uk\UOE\User\R\R-4.0.0\library\nimble\include'.
That flag should have "-I" followed by the path to where nimble is
installed on your computer (and within that to the 'include'
subdirectory). Is the "isad.ssadroot.ex.ac.uk\..." path actually
pointing to a directory on your computer?

Also if you run ".libPaths()" in R, what do you get?

-chris

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Issue installing Nimble with Rtools 40
parts:
Hi Debbie,

It looks like nimble is installed on network filesystem rather than locally on your computer?  That might be the problem somehow. Perhaps it is related to whether the slashes are forwardslashes or backslashes or the number of slashes. 

Can you install nimble locally on your computer (i.e., in a directory on your hard drive)? 

-chris
